chunks: That is so as they were averse to what has been revealed by God, and their actions will be nullified.
ai.seo_question: Why were the deeds of the disbelievers nullified according to Surah Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the causal link between intellectual rejection of the Qur'an and the spiritual nullification of deeds, emphasizing that mere action without conviction is insufficient. It underscores the principle that divine acceptance depends on aligning one's inner belief with the revealed truth, a concept central to the Shia understanding of *Iman* (faith) and *Amal* (action).
